Name: Teatre Barcelona
Company description: Teatre Barcelona es un portal de artes escénicas de Barcelona creado por espectadores y para espectadores. Contiene información exhaustiva sobre todos los espectáculos de la capital catalana i recomendaciones de los usuarios y colaboradores, un blog con toda la actualidad teatral, acceso a la compra de entradas, y un club de usuarios que dinamiza la Comunidad TB.

Name: Nowy Teatr W Warszawie
Company description: Nowy Teatr W Warszawie is a vibrant cultural institution dedicated to the production of theatrical performances and other artistic events, including music and dance. As a municipal cultural center, its mission is to foster creativity and innovation in the performing arts, while also engaging with the community through educational programs and workshops. The theater aims to present contemporary Polish theater and choreography, showcasing the latest trends and phenomena to both local and international audiences. It actively collaborates with various partners, including educational institutions and cultural festivals, to promote artistic exchange and development. With a focus on inclusivity, Nowy Teatr offers special ticket prices for students, teachers, and seniors, ensuring access to the arts for a diverse audience.

Name: Fondazione Teatro Comunale Di Bologna
Company description: Fondazione Teatro Comunale Di Bologna is a prestigious cultural institution dedicated to the performing arts, particularly opera, dance, and symphonic concerts. Its mission is to promote and preserve the rich tradition of Italian opera while also embracing contemporary works, thereby enriching the cultural landscape of Bologna and beyond. The foundation collaborates with renowned artists, conductors, and directors, and features a diverse program that includes classic operas, modern dance performances, and symphonic concerts, appealing to a wide audience. With a commitment to accessibility, it offers discounted tickets for students, fostering a new generation of opera and music enthusiasts. The foundation's partnerships with local and international cultural organizations further enhance its reach and impact, making it a vital hub for artistic expression and community engagement.

Name: Teatro A Teatro
Company description: Noticias, cartelera y venta de entradas para musicales, espectáculos y obras teatrales. Base de datos de teatros, empresas, compañías y profesionales del mundo del teatro, y en general, de las artes escénicas. Site de teatro más visitado de España. Próxima expansión internacional.

Name: Abundo
Company description: Abundo for companies Abundo provides unlimited tickets to cultural events for your entire team, resulting in higher retention rates, increased employee engagement, positive word-of-mouth and better recruitment opportunities. By offering Abundo memberships, you can also improve employee well-being, which has been linked to improved quality of life, psychological well-being, social engagement and reduced experience of depression and anxiety. Contact us at business@abundolive.de to find out more about our B2B offer in Berlin and take advantage of this innovative way to improve your company culture. Abundo Abundo is a new subscription service that offers unlimited tickets to live shows and all kinds of cultural events. Sign up for a monthly fee and discover the cultural scene of your city without limits. You will discover new venues, meet new artists and make lots of great memories! Try it today and go to more concerts, theatre, opera, dance, stand-up, art exhibitions and films than ever before! You can cancel your membership at any time - so you can try us out risk-free. New live events are added every day.

Name: Dedalofurioso
Company description: Dedalofurioso società cooperativa nasce nel 2003. L’interesse dei soci spazia tra diversi linguaggi artistici e si caratterizza per un forte senso di sperimentazione e di contaminazione. Negli anni si è sviluppato un gruppo di lavoro che ha incontrato diverse realtà artistiche e con esse ha dialogato e si è confrontato. La cooperativa Dedalofurioso produce teatro, programma laboratori e workshop,  promuove la collaborazione tra artisti, organizza spettacoli e rassegne in campo teatrale, musicale e cinematografico. Si occupa della valorizzazione del patrimonio artistico nel campo dello spettacolo. Organizza eventi e attiva corsi e incontri di approfondimento per la formazione di un pubblico cosciente e attivo. Conta tra i soci alcuni tecnici esperti e apprezzati nel mondo dello spettacolo, chiamati a lavorare in ambito teatrale, musicale e in importanti eventi. La cooperativa attualmente conta un decina di soci. Da giugno 2013 ha rinnovato la decennale collaborazione con il Comune di Dueville con una nuova convenzione. Gestisce la programmazione e l’organizzazione tecnica ed artistica del cinema teatro Busnelli di Dueville(VI), avvalendosi dell’ausilio di alcuni gruppi locali. Nelle ultime tre stagioni sono stati organizzati presso il cinema teatro più di 320 eventi, con un totale di 22400 biglietti venduti. Soci e collaboratori condividono la curiosità e l’interesse per i diversi linguaggi espressivi e di sperimentazione, con la convinzione che sia sempre più importante dare un contributo di qualità al mondo di oggi. E che l’arte e lo spettacolo offrono gli strumenti necessari alla crescita degli individui e della società, al superamento delle situazioni di crisi e disagio, allo sviluppo di un senso critico e di una solidarietà civile.

Name: Bentobox - Escola De Dança
HQ Location: Portugal, Setúbal, Setúbal, 28 Rua Da Saúde, 2900-633
Company description: «Viver assim é muito mais divertido!» A bentobox é uma escola de dança que pretende ir de encontro às necessidades dançantes da comunidade setubalense. Através da dança e da sua riqueza expressiva, promove a socialização, o enriquecimento cultural e o bem estar físico e mental da população. A bentobox oferece uma mensalidade "do tipo ginásio" em que os seus clientes podem frequentar todas as modalidades por entrada. O nome bentobox tem a sua origem no apelido da promotora principal deste projeto. Aliado a box, tem a sua associação a boombox (rádio portátil) que esteve no seu auge durante os anos 80 e 90, associado a culturas criativas, como o hiphop. As pessoas levavam o rádio para a rua e confraternizavam, dançando. bentobox também significa caixa de take-away na cultura japonesa. Nós, em vez de juntarmos comida à caixa, juntamos arte e boa disposição para reconforto da alma.

Name: Gate Theatre
Company description: The Gate Theatre was founded in 1928 by Micheál MacLiammóir and Hilton Edwards, and very quickly built a unique reputation as a producing house for introducing international writers and artists to Ireland. The theatre is housed in a beautiful Georgian building and has a capacity of 371 seats, which makes it attractively intimate for both actors and audiences alike.  The Gate’s vision is ‘an Open Gate where every person has access to great theatre.’ Under the shared leadership of CEOs, Róisín McBrinn and Colm O’Callaghan, an Open Gate is a civic Gate and will be a key cultural asset to Dublin’s North Inner City.  In the coming years, we will generate new audiences and excite current ones, invest in artists of the future, deliver our GATEWAYS community engagement programme and be a supportive home to the best Irish artists and their international collaborators. As the Gate approaches its centenary in 2028, we will make its theatre a home to all stories and the Gate’s communities, so that it continues to play a defining role in Irish society.  Registered Charity Number CHY 11638. Contact Box Office: Phone   01 874 4045 Email    boxoffice@gate-theatre.ie

Name: VoordeMensen
HQ Location: Netherlands, North Holland, Amsterdam, Nieuwe Achtergracht, 1018
Company description: VoordeMensen - Kaartverkoopsysteem voor podia en events   Met VoordeMensen verkoop je tickets voor al je voorstellingen en evenementen. Online en realtime. Razendsnel, makkelijk, overzichtelijk en betaalbaar. En of je nou één zaal hebt, of een festival draait met 80 voorstellingen op 30 locaties: VoordeMensen werkt. Als je regelmatig concerten, voorstellingen of events organiseert, wil je natuurlijk zo veel mogelijk kaartjes verkopen. Liefst zonder veel gedoe, want je hebt het al druk genoeg. Maar wel zo dat het makkelijk en leuk is om een kaartje te kopen. Daarbij wil je direct toegang hebben tot alle nodige gegevens, van verkoopstanden tot borderellen en van voorstellingsdetails tot bezoekersoverzichten. VoordeMensen kan je hierbij helpen. Wij doen het voor de mensen, dus ook voor jou én voor je bezoekers! Ga voor meer informatie naar www.voordemensen.nl of neem contact met ons op via 020 - 427 28 28 | info@voordemensen.nl

Name: Magma Events
Company description: Magma Events nasce in Sardegna (IT) nel 2021 dall’esperienza congiunta di professionisti del settore dell’intrattenimento. Attraverso la realizzazione di numerosi eventi, tra cui il Red Valley Festival (Olbia, SS) e l'innovativo festival in mezzo al mare Water World Music Festival 2021 (Olbia, SS), negli anni abbiamo maturato e consolidato competenze specifiche in tutti i campi necessari per lo sviluppo e la produzione di spettacoli di livello internazionale, caratterizzati da importanti produzioni e line up con ospiti di fama mondiale. I punti di forza di Magma Events sono le capacità di organizzazione, la creatività nella comunicazione e la possibilità di offrire un pacchetto completo, suddiviso in fasi, per la progettazione e la realizzazione di eventi unici nel loro genere. Dai format innovativi in mezzo al mare, ai Festival su terra con oltre 100 mila persone, passando per le produzioni di grandi manifestazioni e concerti per conto di pubbliche amministrazioni ed enti: ci occupiamo di realizzare eventi iconici che rimangano impressi nella memoria dei partecipanti. Il team di Magma Events si occupa di tutti i passaggi necessari per la produzione completa di qualsiasi tipo di evento: dalla progettazione e allestimento della venue all’impostazione delle strategie di comunicazione e marketing per la promozione dell’evento, passando poi per la programmazione artistica e la vendita diretta dei biglietti, fino all’operatività e la cura della logistica sul posto. Scopri di più sui nostri progetti e servizi: - www.magmaevents.com - www.redvalleyfestival.com - www.cagliarisummerfestival.com - www.capodannodicagliari.com - www.waterworldmusicfestival.com

Name: Rialto Theatre Limassol
HQ Location: Cyprus, Limassol, Limassol, Andrea Drousioti Str., 3040
Company description: The Rialto Theatre manages and produces cultural events from Cyprus and abroad, while implementing theatre, film, dance and music events, hosting them mostly, yet not exclusively, in its own theatre. Some of its own productions, organised in collaboration with other institutions, have been presented to theatres in other cities, squares, ancient theatres and elsewhere. For many years now, the Rialto Theatre has been organising and producing the following annual events and festivals in collaboration with the Cultural Services of the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports and Youth: Cyprus Film Days International Festival, International Short Film Festival of Cyprus, Cyprus Contemporary Dance Festival, Cyprus Choreography Platform, Drama Short Film Festival travels to Cyprus, Cyprus Jazz and World Music Showcase, and since March 2020, the Cyprus Choreography Showcase aiming to present the work of Cypriot choreographers internationally. The Rialto Theatre disposes of a large network of spectators, having established effective mechanisms for the promotion and screening of events, as well as an electronic ticketing system. La piattaforma è pensata anche come innovativo strumento per le compagnie professionali, i teatri e gli operatori culturali.  Online gli artisti possono caricare schede dettagliate di tutti i loro spettacoli, mettere in evidenza le date del singolo spettacolo e accedere ad una sezione riservata, trasformando così la piattaforma in una vera e propria vetrina promozionale. Per i teatri e gli operatori culturali TIPStheater è un punto di riferimento per scoprire le compagnie e gli spettacoli più apprezzati dal pubblico e per conoscere la disponibilità, i prezzi e le esigenze tecniche degli artisti. Tramite una sezione pubblica dedicata agli spazi culturali, TIPStheater permette ai gestori di luoghi pubblici e teatri di far conoscere meglio tutte le offerte e i servizi dedicati agli spettatori.

Company description: A APPACDM da Maia - Associação Portuguesa de Pais e Amigos do Cidadão Deficiente Mental, é uma instituição particular de solidariedade social que presta serviços a cidadãos com deficiência mental, promovendo a sua integração na sociedade e apoiando as suas famílias. A sua génese remonta à APADIM, criada em março de 1981, sendo mais tarde integrada na APPACDM do Porto. Em 2004 adquire a sua autonomia enquanto APPACDM da Maia. Em 2015, a instituição viu um dos seus grandes sonhos realizados, com a inauguração e entrada em funcionamento de um moderno edifício em Vila Nova da Telha, onde já funciona um Centro de Atividades Ocupacionais (CAO) e o tão aguardado Lar Residencial. Este equipamento veio juntar-se aos dois Centros de Atividades Ocupacionais já existentes, em Vermoim e S. Pedro de Avioso. As respostas sociais disponibilizadas pela APPACDM da Maia recebem cidadãos maiores de dezasseis anos que não conseguem outra forma de integração social, e que aqui desenvolvem diversas atividades adaptadas às suas capacidades cognitivas e psicomotoras, nomeadamente: Educação Musical, Educação Física, Boccia, Musculação, Natação, Terapia Ocupacional, Psicologia, Artesanato, Hidromassagem, Expressão Corporal, Snoezelen e Treino de competências sociais. Existe ainda uma forte componente experiencial, com a realização de diversas visitas culturais. Atualmente, a instituição acolhe 20 utentes no seu Lar Residencial e 70 nos seus CAO’s, apoiados por uma equipa com cerca de 50 colaboradores, entre auxiliares, psicólogos, assistentes sociais e terapeutas ocupacionais. Dispõe de uma frota adaptada de 3 viaturas. A APPACDM da Maia trabalha ainda para que os utentes mais autónomos possam desenvolver atividades fora da instituição (as designadas Atividades Socialmente Úteis – ASU), tendo já celebrado um protocolo com o Jardim Zoológico da Maia, e esperando-se, em breve, estabelecer novas parcerias.

Company description: La Kuore di Roma Onlus nasce nel 2007 per aiutare i bambini bielorussi e le loro famiglie. Nel 2012 viene costituita l'Ass. Kuore di Roma con lo scopo di aiutare e assistere le famiglie indigenti del territorio di Roma. Missione La Missione della Kuore di Roma Onlus La Kuore di Roma Onlus ha iniziato nel 2007 ad operare a favore dei bambini di Chernobyl avviando progetti d’accoglienza. I bambini che ancora oggi sono colpiti dai danni derivanti dal disastro nucleare di Chernobyl. I bambini accolti dalla Kuore di Roma Onlus sono ospitati da famiglie volontarie, che partecipano alle spese attraverso una quota partecipativa (spese del biglietto aereo, trasporto, visto ecc.) e in struttura, in quest’ultimo caso è la Onlus che si carica di tutte le spese necessarie per consentire l’alloggio e la permanenza in una struttura adeguata. - La missione dell'Associazione Kuore di Roma  L’Associazione Kuore di Roma, nata nel febbraio 2012, è una realtà in cui operano volontari e operatori che offrono tempo, sensibilità, professionalità e motivazione al fine di combattere le forme di indigenza, emarginazione, solitudine e discriminazione. Il lavoro dell’Associazione viene realizza soprattutto nel XII (ex XVI) Municipio di Roma Capitale e si concretizza in diverse azioni che mirano tutte ad un unico grande scopo: il sostegno reciproco come strategia di lotta alla crisi e all’emarginazione. E’ proprio nel tentativo di realizzare questo obiettivo che all’interno dell’Associazione è nato il Movimento Solidale “Punto e a Capo”, spazio di condivisione in cui gli iscritti, coordinati dagli operatori dell’Associazione, si impegnano in attività di mutuo scambio e “fanno rete” donando il proprio tempo per aiutare l’altro e uscire così da situazioni di abbandono e sfiducia, dalle difficoltà quotidiane, riscoprendo valori importanti quali l’empatia, la solidarietà, l’emancipazione e l’impegno individuale.

Name: AAUE - Associação Académica Da Universidade De Évora

A AAUE representa desde 1978 os estudantes desta academia interna e externamente. Ao nível interno a AAUÉ tem assento no Senado Universitário, no Conselho de Acção Social, no Conselho de Avaliação, no Conselho Consultivo do Fundo de Ação Social da UÉ, no Gabinete para a Promoção do Sucesso Académico, no Conselho Desportivo da UÉ, no Conselho da Fundação Luís de Molina e na Assembleia de Representantes. Ao nível externo a AAUÉ desempenha um papel político junto das outras associações congéneres, no Ministério da Educação e Ciência e está representada em órgãos estatais e regionais. Faz ainda parte do Fórum Académico para a Informação e Representação Externa (FAIRe) e na Federação Académica do Desporto Universitário (FADU), na qual é membro fundador. A AAUÉ faz ainda parte do Conselho Municipal de Juventude, do Conselho Consultivo Regional do IPDJ e do Conselho Municipal de Educação. Para além do trabalho político a AAUÉ promove atividades culturais e desportivas e presta aos seus membros, os estudantes, serviços variados, desde o lazer e a informação à formação extracurricular. A primeira página de Internet da AAUE data de 1998. A AAUE diferencia-se ainda a nível nacional pelo fato de facultar a alunos bolseiros bilhetes a preço de sócio para a Queima das Fitas e Receção ao Caloiro prática que teve início pela primeira vez em 1999. A AAUÉ está organizada em sectores, cada um com a sua área de intervenção e competências bem definidas

Name: Football Supporters Europe
Company description: Football Supporters Europe (FSE) is the democratic voice of European football fans: Founded in 2008 at the first European Football Fans Congress; registered in Germany; and active in 55 UEFA nations. We are an independent, non-profit association of fans recognised as a representative body on fan issues by institutions such as UEFA and the Council of Europe. We recognise that fans are the heart and soul of football. We believe fans are entitled to watch their team in a safe environment, whatever their background, enjoy the same freedoms as the general public, and have a bigger say on how the game is run. And we envisage a more equal, competitive, and sustainable football—one that works for everybody, not just a select few. To this end, we are committed to lobbying UEFA and other governing bodies on everything from maintaining sporting merit in European competitions and protecting domestic football to defending fans’ rights and lower ticket prices. We know the best way to achieve our vision and objectives is through collective action, solidarity, and democracy. Our core principles emphasise all three: - Opposition to any form of discrimination (including discrimination based on ethnic origin, ability, religion and belief, gender, sexual orientation, and age). - Rejection of violence, both verbal and physical. - Empowerment of grassroots football supporters. - Promotion of a positive football and supporters’ culture, including values such as fair play and good governance.

Name: AEPTC | Associação Empresarial Portugal Colombia
Company description: QUEM SOMOS A Associação Empresarial Portugal Colômbia (AEPTC) é uma associação empresarial de entidades singulares e coletivas devidamente licenciadas que, nos territórios nacional e colombiano, exercem a sua atividade nas mais diferentes áreas económicas. Criada por um grupo de empresários portugueses de diferentes sectores económicos, esta iniciativa resultou da vontade de promover um intercâmbio económico entre as empresas portuguesas e colombianas, numa primeira fase, e posteriormente com as empresas que façam negócios em toda a América Latina.  A Colômbia é a quinta economia e o terceiro país mais populoso da América Latina, depois do Brasil e do México, estimando-se que a respetiva população tenha atingido aproximadamente 48 milhões de habitantes, em 2016.  Dados de 2017 revelam que aproximadamente 500 empresas portuguesas já exportam para a Colômbia, com a maior subida de posição no Ranking Doing Business de 2007 – 2016. Apresenta um crescimento médio do PIB, entre 2010 e 2015, de 4,5%.  De qualquer forma, Portugal tem menor expressão no comércio externo da Colômbia como fornecedor do que como cliente, tendo ocupado a 29ª posição, enquanto cliente e o 42º lugar, como fornecedor com uma percentagem de 0,20% relativa ao montante global das importações. Neste contexto económico, devemos olhar para a Colômbia como um mercado apetecível para as empresas portuguesas que deverão olhar para aquele país como uma janela de oportunidades. Também as empresas colombianas deverão olhar para Portugal como um país parceiro para o desenvolvimento e implementação de negócios pois estamos a falar de uma excelente porta de entrada para o mercado Europeu.  Foi a pensar neste enorme intercâmbio económico que nasce a Associação Empresarial Portugal Colômbia que tem por objetivo dinamizar ações/iniciativas que possam acrescentar valor a todos os nossos associados.  geral@aeptc.pt

Name: OSPT Alliance
Company description: OSPT Alliance is a lean, member-driven association shaping the future of secure, open, and interoperable transit systems. Flying Angels ha professionalizzato e reso gratuito il servizio di trasferimento (bambini-famiglia-medici) offrendo così un servizio trasversale e integrativo a tutti coloro che lavorano a favore della tutela della salute dell’infanzia. Company description: Inclusion rocks! Music for All. Berlin based charity Handiclapped organizes and promotes barrier-free live music along this motto. Additionally over 50 band and dance workshops could be organized.  The “Handiclapped Band” was founded ten years ago and today rocks at around 20 gigs each year.  2 congresses for “Live music and inclusion” have been organized in Berlin in 2017 and 2019.  Main goal is, to make barrier-free live music happen as often and for as many people as possible, to create occasions to experience music as a common language that brings people with different backgrounds together at eye and ear level.   To make access to live music as easy as possible for all, Handiclapped concerts start at around 6 pm (starting times often being critical, to prevent having to negotiate night shift conditions with caretaking services) and always in barrier-free locations. Tickets cost only 5 Euro, assistants get in for free. Because of the high cost involved with organizing concerts there is always a financial gap that needs to be filled by donations. Damit führt er das weltweite Album-Ranking an. Kein Künstler hat in irgendeinem Land der Welt mehr Nummer-eins-Alben veröffentlicht als Peter Maffay in Deutschland.  Anfang 2020 ging Maffay mit seiner Band auf 50 Jahre Peter Maffay - LIVE 2020 Tour. Mit über 200.000 verkauften Tickets waren die Arenen in 22 deutschen Städten ausverkauft.  Peter Maffay erhielt für mehr als 50 Millionen verkaufte Tonträger zahlreiche Gold- Platinauszeichnungen. Neben sechs Echos, darunter zwei Mal „Künstler des Jahres“, wurden ihm viele andere Musikawards verliehen.

Name: Classictic
Company description: More than one million people use Classictic.com to find tickets to classical music performances on stages worldwide. Whether you are a dedicated classical music fan, an opera expert, or a newcomer looking for a musical experience at home or abroad, Classictic makes it easy. Established in 2002 by Eivind Jåsund, Classictic is a Berlin-­‐based internet portal specialized in the sale of tickets for classical concerts and opera worldwide. Classictic is proud to cooperate directly with over 400 venues and arts organizations to offer easy and secure booking in eight languages, with 24 hour call centre customer service and support.  The Classictic team On a typical day at our office in Berlin, you might hear French, Chinese, Czech, or Spanish. There are 10 nationalities represented in our team, and although we don’t all support the same soccer team, we all share an interest in classical music, and a passion for providing excellent service.

Company description: KINO ŚWIAT is the leading film distributor in Poland, active at all fields of film exploitation: Theatrical distribution, Home Entertainment production and distribution, Video on Demand sales, TV sales. KINO ŚWIAT is also active at the field of film production and co-production, both domestically and internationally. For the last 8 years KINO ŚWIAT has been the biggest independent film distributor in Poland in terms of theatrical market share. Several times including 2014, 2016, 2017 year KINO ŚWIAT has become the ultimate market leader, including all the Hollywood studios operating in Poland. KINO ŚWIAT has been honoured with many awards as the Best Distributor by Polish Film Institute, Polish Cinemas Association and Polish Filmmakers Association, as well as FORBES Diamonds award as the best yearly value growth company. KINO ŚWIAT has also been nominated as the Best European Distributor of animated films by Cartoon Movie. KINO ŚWIAT’S film catalogue consists of almost 2,000 titles. The catalogue includes almost 400 movies which were theatrically distributed by KINO ŚWIAT. The catalogue includes over 100 Polish films, many of which were not only distributed but also co-produced by KINO ŚWIAT. The catalogue includes over 30 films from annual Top 20 in the Polish box office including the Polish films with biggest admissions ever: Listy do M 1, 2, 3, Pitbul Niebezpieczne kobiety, Pitbul Ostatni Pies, Botox, Planeta Singli, Kobiety Mafii. KINO ŚWIAT is operating the most popular YouTube movie channel in Poland (40 million views) and the most popular Facebook movie fanpage in Poland (over half a million users).

Name: 4 CATS PICTURES
HQ Location: Spain, Catalonia, Barcelona, 16 Carrer De La Lleialtat, 08001
Company description: Founded in 2013, 4 CATS Pictures first feature-length animated film was "Capture the Flag" (Enrique Gato), a co-production with Telecinco Cinema, Telefónica Studios, Ikiru Films and Lightbox Entertaiment. The company’s second production was "Tad the Lost Explorer and the Secret of King Midas" (Enrique Gato), another blockbuster that, among others, received again in 2018 the Goya, Gaudí and Platino awards for the Best Animation Film. In 2018, 4 CATS produced with Ikiru Films the thriller "El Pacto" (David Victori); in 2020 co-produced "Malasaña 32" (Alberto Pintó), and "El verano que vivimos" (Carlos Sedes). In 2022, released "Live is life. La gran aventura" (Dani de la Torre), a youth comedy with a script by Albert Espinosa that 4 CATS co-produced with Atresmedia Cine and Live is life AIE. Distribution was handled by Warner Bros.; the movie has been a big success in Netflix. Currently, 4 CATS is preparing the worldwide release of its latest animated film "Mummies" (J.J. García Galocha “Galo”), an adventure comedy with romantic airs distributed by Warner Bros. As new projects, 4 CATS is working on its next animated film titled "Little Big Boy" (Pedro Solís & J.J. García Galocha “Galo”), inspired in the story “Cuerdas” by Pedro Solís, and prepares two real action movies for 2023.

Name: Göteborg Wind Orchestra
Company description: Göteborg Wind Orchestra bildades i sin nuvarande form 1992. Orkestern har sina rötter i Göteborgs Spårvägars Musikkår från 1905 och hette mellan 1992 och 2007 GöteborgsMusiken. Den klassiska repertoaren blandas med underhållningskonserter, jazzkonserter, barn- och ungdomsproduktioner,  familjekonserter och traditionell militärmusik. Ett stort antal av våra främsta solister och artister inom respektive genrer gästar årligen Göteborg Wind Orchestra i olika konsertproduktioner. Vi bedriver också ett långsiktigt samarbete med några av Sveriges främsta körer. Göteborg Wind Orchestra finansieras i huvudsak av Göteborgs Stad och­ ­Statens Kulturråd samt med hjälp av egen finansiering. Egenfinansieringen består av bland annat biljettförsäljning, sponsring och ett uppdrag för försvaret att verka som Flygvapnets Musikkår. Utöver konserter i Kronhuset och i övriga lokaler i Göteborg genomför Göteborg Wind Orchestra turnéverksamhet i Västra Götalandsregionen samt även internationellt.

Name: Wanted Cinema
Company description: Nata nel 2014, la casa di distribuzione milanese Just Wanted (aka Wanted Cinema) riesce nel giro di pochi anni a diventare un punto di riferimento nel mercato cinematografico italiano, proponendosi con una linea editoriale molto chiara: un cinema di ricerca e "ricercato"; per un pubblico che si aspetta non soltanto divertimento, ma anche pensiero, stimolo, dibattito, sorpresa, approfondimento. Tra gli oltre 130 titoli distribuiti sono presenti film e documentari, vincitori dei principali festival nazionali e internazionali, premiati dal pubblico, dalla critica e con ottimi riscontri anche al Box Office. Tra questi i candidati all' Oscar Alla mia piccola Sama, Estate 1993, Corpus Christi, RBG, e il premio Oscar come miglior film d’animazione Parvana, prodotto da Angelina Jolie.  Wanted Cinema vanta all’interno del suo catalogo anche alcuni tra gli autori più acclamati e premiati come Werner Herzog (Nomad-In cammino con Bruce Chatwin), Raoul Peck (I am not your negro, Il giovane Karl Marx), Ladj Ly (A voce alta), Chloe Zhao (The Rider). Questi ultimi due grandi autori sono stati portati in Italia per la prima volta proprio da Wanted.  Nell’aprile 2020 Wanted inaugura la piattaforma digitale “Wanted Zone” per cercare un’alternativa alla chiusura delle sale cinematografiche dovuta alla pandemia. La piattaforma è andata incontro a varie trasformazioni nel corso dei mesi finché è riuscita a imporsi come valida alternativa alle tante piattaforme di cinema di qualità sorte nello stesso periodo. Su Wanted Zone sono visibili tanti dei film di catalogo ma anche nuove proposte ed eventi organizzati in live streaming con ospiti speciali e i cast dei film.

Name: Mass Market Recordings
Company description: So who in his right mind would still want to start a record company? It used to be the dream of every music fan. Pick the bands you love and share your favorite music with the general public. But in the dark days of 2009, running a traditional record label does not exactly sound like your one way ticket to becoming a millionaire overnight. Enter Mass Market Recordings. Because we still buy cd (remember, those shiny silver round things in plastic boxes). We still attend concerts. We still read music magazines. And every year, we are still completely blown away by new great artists and wonderful new songs. We started Mass Market Recordings  because we still believe in bringing the music we love to an audience that still wants to hear it. And so we raise a glass to what we believe in.

Name: Konzertdirektion Prof. Victor Hohenfels
Company description: "Sit back and enjoy a few hours of assured relaxation and harmony listening to the ever popular masterpieces of famous composers in the splendidly festive atmosphere of a packed house." This has always been the motto informing „Popular Concerts“, created by Prof. Victor Hohenfels and his wife Eva-Maria more than 50 years ago.  Since the beginning and for more than 5 decades these concerts have been capable of attracting such a large audience, that their staging could take place independent of state subsidies. Held in Berlin Philharmonic Hall, today these concerts remarkably contribute to making the German capital the world’s major centre for performing arts. During the last 50 years more than three million concertgoers from around the world have attended these „Popular Concerts“. The most famous and popular works existing in music literature are presented to the audience, thematically grouped around series such as „World Symphonism", „Composer Portraits" or „Classic and Romantic Masterpieces". The traditional concerts held during the Christmas and Easter seasons include beloved evergreens, such as Schubert's „Unfinished Symphony“, Beethoven's „Eroica“ and Maurice Ravel's „Boléro“, while New Year's Day is reserved for Beethoven's Ninth Symphony with its „Ode to Joy“ final movement. The „Sinfonie Orchester Berlin“, with its Principal Conductor Stanley Dodds and many other famous conductors and solists, have performed since the very beginning in the stupendous auditorium of the Berlin Philharmonic Hall, one of the world's most beautiful concert halls, with unrivalled acoustics. We welcome you all to experience the sheer magic of our "Popular Concerts"! TEL.: +49 | 30 | 8 82 76 22 / 23 Mon. – Fr. 10 am to 4 pm Tickets: tickets@konzertdirektion-hohenfels.de General Information | Contact: info@konzertdirektion-hohenfels.de

Company description: Downtown Riot is a newly started experience festival with breadth that should be easily accessible in an urban environment for anyone who appreciates rock, hard rock and metal. The festival will have its premiere 6-7 May 2022 at Fållan - a unique venue in the Slakthus area, right next to the Globe in Stockholm. In addition to presenting an attractive and well-balanced line-up with everything from classic rock to leaden metal, the focus is on the overall experience. Those who bought a ticket should feel welcomed and surprised when they arrive and when it's time to go home, they should feel that they really got value for money. Even between the show, there will be interesting and relevant activities on stage, so no one feels that they want to leave the area. BACKGROUND The initiative for Downtown Riot was taken in early 2021 by Jonas Lööw, founder of Rockbladet.se - one of Sweden's largest and oldest online magazines about rock, hard rock and metal. Name: Celtic Collections Ltd
HQ Location: Ireland, Leinster, Dublin, 185 Rathmines Road Lower
Company description: Celtic Collections is an Irish independent record label founded in 1996, and based in Dublin, Ireland. Celtic Collections specialises in Irish traditional and Celtic music, and has built up a large catalogue of prestigious albums by Irish artists. Celtic Collections’ evolution over time has seen it grow to nurture and promote Irish artists, particularly outside Ireland. In May 2004 David Kavanagh’s Liffey Records purchased the Celtic Collections label. Irish music businessman and former manager of Clannad, David Kavanagh had, in 1993, set up the successful record label, Celtic Heartbeat, with Paul McGuinness, then manager of U2. Celtic Heartbeat capitalised on the resurgence of interest in Irish music, notably in America. Its first major success was an album based on the music from the phenomenally successful theatrical show, Riverdance. David Kavanagh’s marketing strategy included a thorough refurbishment of the way in which the label’s music – as well as the overall image of Irish music - was represented internationally. The label’s emphasis was on improving recording standards for an audience whose tastes were becoming more attuned & sophisticated. One of the most successful of releases under the new owners of Celtic Collections was Celtic Woman. From their debut release in 2005, Celtic Woman have gone on to sell over 10 million albums and DVDs and 4 million tickets worldwide, and have been nominated for a Grammy award in 2016. David Kavanagh continued to build the Celtic Collections catalogue and promote Irish music sales around the world.  In 2008, Celtic Collections had signed another very successful music act – The High Kings, an Irish folk/ballad group that has gone on to achieve huge success across Ireland, the UK, Europe and America. In 2016, Janine Nallen joined Celtic Collections as CEO.

Name: SHARE Festival Barcelona

Company description: SHARE Festival es un nuevo festival que nació en Barcelona en el verano de 2018. La temática principal es la felicidad, y el evento propone dos posibles caminos en busca de ella: Música y Solidaridad. La música, a través de los conciertos de los artistas que transmiten un mensaje alegre y optimista. La solidaridad, porque creemos que el mejor camino hacia la felicidad es compartir.  SHARE Festival es el primer festival que ofrece al público la posibilidad de ganar entradas con diferentes acciones solidarias que se podrán realizar a través de la app oficial del festival o en la web. Las principales acciones se relacionan con el cambio climático, los derechos humanos, la igualdad de género, el desarrollo de la educación infantil y el fin de la pobreza extrema. Las acciones se pueden realizar a través de un simple click en Facebook y Twitter, firmando peticiones online y escaneando códigos QR. Cumpliendo las acciones se acumularán puntos, que servirán para entrar en el sorteo y ganar entradas del festival y de otros eventos musicales. Durante y después del festival se medirá y presentará el impacto real que han logrado las acciones de los asistentes en la vida de miles de personas. SHARE FESTIVAL es un festival pensado para una nueva generación llena de valores a la que queremos dar voz y espacio.

Name: Orquesta Sinfónica Camerata Musicalis
Company description: La Orquesta Sinfónica Camerata Musicalis nació en 2004 con el firme propósito de hacer la música clásica accesible a todos los públicos y desarrollar una visión de concierto novedosa y personal. Su atrevida apuesta ha obtenido una gran acogida por parte de los espectadores y de la crítica, que han sabido apreciar y valorar una labor didáctica que está triunfando en todos los auditorios en los que actúa. Desde 2015, Camerata Musicalis ha girado por la Red de Teatros de la Comunidad de Madrid con su espectáculo ‘¿Por qué es especial?’, un formato transgresor de conciertos de sinfonías clásicas que son explicadas en una primera parte muy entretenida en la que se mezclan elementos de otras artes escénicas y que ya han podido disfrutar más de 5.000 espectadores. ‘¿Por qué es especial?’, que se estrenó con la ‘Sinfonía del Nuevo Mundo’ de Dvorak, ha pasado ya por una veintena de auditorios y teatros, entre los que destacan el Teatro de la Luz Philips Gran Vía y el Cofidis Alcázar, en los que Camerata Musicalis ha colgado el cartel de ‘No hay billetes’ en todas sus actuaciones. La ‘Pastoral’ y la ‘Eroica’ de Beethoven, la ‘Júpiter’ de Mozart, la ‘Inacabada’ de Schubert, la ‘Italiana’ de Mendelssohn, los ‘Reales fuegos artificiales’ de Haendel o la ‘Serenata para cuerdas’ de Tchaikovsky han formado parte hasta el momento del repertorio de ‘¿Por qué es especial?’, el proyecto más exitoso de Camerata Musicalis. Toda esta trayectoria le ha valido a Camerata Musicalis para ser incluida desde el año 2015 en el prestigioso ‘Libro de Oro’ de la música española.

The clip from a newspaper printed in 1846 and depicting rowing competition is the oldest item. One of the most valuable exhibits is a ticket to the World Rowing Championship of 1884. Alongside with the old items there are also nowadays books about rowing and every visitor can browse them.

Name: Stedelijk Museum Alkmaar
Company description: Stedelijk Museum Alkmaar is a vibrant cultural institution that combines art, history, and community engagement in the heart of Alkmaar. The museum features a café that serves delicious organic and locally sourced dishes, creating a unique dining experience that reflects the museum's commitment to sustainability and local culture. Visitors can enjoy fair trade coffee, collection-inspired lunch options, and a selection of wines and local beers, all while surrounded by exhibitions of glass and pottery. The museum café is open to everyone, with or without an admission ticket, making it a welcoming space for both locals and tourists. Stedelijk Museum Alkmaar aims to foster a love for art and culture, offering group lunch options and guided tours to enhance the visitor experience. The museum collaborates with local partners to promote community involvement and enrich its offerings, making it a key destination for cultural exploration in the region.

Company description: Dolní Vítkovice jsou světově unikátní areál, kde se mezi lety 1828 až 1998 těžilo uhlí a vyrábělo surové železo. Name: Amos Rex
Company description: Amos Rex is a contemporary art museum located in Helsinki, Finland, dedicated to showcasing innovative exhibitions that engage with the emotional and experiential aspects of art. The museum's mission is to create a space where art can evoke a range of feelings, from isolation to empathy, as exemplified by its current exhibition, "I Feel, For Now," which features over a hundred artworks from its own collections. To enhance visitor experience, Amos Rex offers free guided introductions for the price of an entrance ticket, providing attendees with thematic insights into exhibitions before they explore the museum further. These introductions are available in Finnish, Swedish, and English, catering to a diverse audience that includes art enthusiasts, students, and families. With a commitment to accessibility, ticket prices are structured to accommodate various demographics, ensuring that everyone can engage with the transformative power of art.

Company description: El CAAM es una institución cultural fundada en el año 1989 y dependiente del Cabildo de Gran Canaria. Este centro de arte, con entrada libre para todos los públicos, ofrece a sus visitantes un programa de exposiciones, de ámbito nacional e internacional, y una intensa agenda de actividades divulgativas vinculadas a la cultura contemporánea. La principal singularidad que distingue a este centro es la vocación tricontinental de sus prácticas artísticas y de pensamiento, que giran en torno a África, América y Europa. El CAAM está situado en el barrio de Vegueta, en el casco antiguo de la ciudad de Las Palmas de Gran Canaria. Sus salas de arte se ubican en el edificio histórico de la calle Los Balcones, rehabilitado por el arquitecto Francisco J. Sáenz de Oiza, y en la plaza de San Antonio Abad. Name: Titanic Experience Cobh
Company description: Titanic Experience Cobh is a new permanent visitor centre located in the original White Star Line Ticket Office in the centre of Cobh town (formally known as Queenstown) in what was the departure point for the final 123 passengers who boarded the Titanic.  The visitor experience is presented in two parts. The first is an exciting immersive audio visual tour retracing the steps of the 123 passengers who boarded Titanic from Queenstown on April 11th 1912. With Officer Boxall as your virtual guide, innovative audio visual technology and the replica interior ship set, experience the anticipation of the long journey ahead and the new life waiting for Queenstown’s passengers in America. Share the excitement of boarding the most luxurious liner of her time and feel the horror of the tragedy on that fateful night. The second part of Titanic Experience examines how it all went wrong; the unbelievable and “almost” impossible sequence of events that occurred to cause Titanic to sink. With computer generated graphics recreating the collision and subsequent sinking, film analysis of the Titanic on the sea bed and expert interviews these interactive exhibits allow visitors to find out how and why the Titanic sank on that fateful night of the 15th April 1912.  Finally, the Story Room of Touchscreen Computers allows one to look at the personalities on board the ship and in particular to discover the fate of the 123 Queenstown passengers.

Name: Visitor Center De Gele Loods Naarden
Company description: Housed in a former Artillery Depot, the Centre offers lots of possibilities for touring, historical and architectural exploration by foot, by bike and even by boat! Our friendly volunteers will be pleased to help you plan your visit, and point you in the right direction with all the tickets, maps and information you need. To get the most out of a visit, spend some time at the complimentary exhibition Naarden and the Dutch Waterlines before venturing out onto the fortress walls.

Name: Museum Rijswijk
Company description: Museum Rijswijk is located in a 17th century mansion and a new wing in the middle of the old center of Rijswijk. The poet Hendrik Tollens (1780-1856) lived in the house, hence the name Tollens House. The museum has an extensive collection of paintings, prints, drawings and photos that have a link with the city of Rijswijk. Museum Rijswijk organizes contemporary art exhibitions (paper and textile art) and heritage exhibitions. One year the museum organizes the Textile Biennale, the next year the Paper Biennale. The /DOC is located in the museum, where a lot of information can be found about Rijswijk's cultural heritage, textile and paper art. The museum regularly organizes guided tours, lectures and workshops for young and old and always has an interesting side program around the exhibitions. School classes are received and workshops take place in the Atelier. The rooms in the museum are ideal for small conferences, receptions, meetings, lunches and dinners. The Salon in the Tollenshuis is one of the most beautiful wedding locations in Rijswijk. At Tollens Café, in the beautiful garden and on the two spacious terraces you can enjoy a coffee with the best apple pie in the world and a simple organic lunch. The museum shop offers an exclusive collection of cards, pop-up books, jewelery, art books and all kinds of goodies made of paper and textile. / DOC, Tollens Café and the museum shop are also accessible without a ticket for the museum.

Name: Weltmuseum Wien
Company description: Weltmuseum Wien is a prominent cultural institution located in the heart of Vienna, dedicated to showcasing the diverse cultural heritage of the world through its extensive collections and exhibitions. The museum's mission is to foster understanding and appreciation of global cultures, promoting dialogue and exchange among visitors from various backgrounds. It offers a range of ticketing options, including unlimited access with an annual pass, making it accessible to a wide audience, including students, seniors, and families. The museum collaborates with various partners to provide educational programs and guided tours tailored for groups, ensuring an enriching experience for all visitors. With a commitment to inclusivity, Weltmuseum Wien strives to be a barrier-free space, welcoming everyone to explore and engage with its rich cultural offerings.

Name: Junibacken
Company description: Junibacken is a vibrant cultural destination that specializes in bringing children's literature to life through engaging theatrical performances. Located in Teaterladan, the company focuses on storytelling theatre, with its current production being "Skinn Skerping – The worst of ghosts in all of Småland," based on the beloved short story by Astrid Lindgren. Aimed at children aged five and up, Junibacken's mission is to spark imagination and explore themes of fear and creativity through delightful and spooky narratives. The company encourages families to prebook their theatre tickets, as seating is limited, ensuring an intimate and memorable experience for its young audience. With a commitment to quality performances, Junibacken collaborates with talented actors, directors, and designers to create captivating shows that resonate with children and their families. Its target market includes families seeking enriching cultural experiences, making it a cherished destination for both locals and visitors.

Name: Historalia Productions
Company description: Organisatie van Musicalspektakels onder de gemeenschappelijke noemer “Historalia Musicalspektakels”. Historalia Productions stelt zich als missie de (her)ontdekking van ons cultureel en historisch patrimonium door middel van muziek- en dansspektakels  van een artistiek hoog  niveau, maar toegankelijk  voor alle leeftijden. Name: FAMu
Company description: The Family Day at Museum, Italy, every year from 2013, in more than 700 museums. The project, this year in its fifth edition, was born out of the experience of www.kidsarttourism.com, a website where you can find all that museums, art sites and cultural associations all over Italy have to offer to families with kids. The number of museums which have begun to offer educational programs and projects specifically conceived for family visits is increasing day by day, thanks also to the excellent standard of the example set by other European countries. Italian museums, too, are finally becoming 'family friendly'! At Kidsarttourism we have a wide knowledge of the educational offer in this field, and we try to put this offer in relationships with the specific needs of families and kids, which we also know quite well. We know how high the demand is for educational activities where the children are given a chance to spend a day, or just an afternoon or a few hours during the weekend learning about art and culture and having fun at the same time. A visit to a museum or to an art exhitition, with reasonable family tickets at affordable prices, would be an excellent opportunity for the whole family to spend some quality time together, which both parents and children would enjoy. Art and culture are not for an élite of intellectuals (grown ups!) only, as many still think, but for everyone. You parents, bring your kids to the museums! And you museums, welcome the children and make them want to discover your treasures! The Family Day at Museum aims at making this possible, showing how museums and families can meet each other's needs in fun and creative ways. So, join in, and have fun!

Name: Kattegatcentret
Company description: The Kattegatcenter is located next to Grenaa harbour, right next to the Kattegat. We can therefore see, smell and feel the ocean every single day. Just the ticket for ocean junkies like us! Luckily, we are not the only ones smitten by the sea. The Kattegatcenter opened in 1993 and since then we have had over 6 million visitors. With us, you can learn all about the oceans – our gifted staff have a wealth of stories you’ll remember forever. With humour and warmth, we give our visitors experiences that spread like ripples in the water. When you know more about the ocean, we think you will take better care of them. We also make our knowledge and facilities available to the business community, academic and research institutions, so together we can ensure the future of our oceans and develop their potential. The Kattegatcenter is a charitable fund and is run on a non-profit basis. In addition to the exhibition areas, the Kattegatcenter has an active schools service, which is used by over 12,000 pupils and students each year. We work with public aquaria and zoos around the world via our memberships of DAZA (Danish Association of Zoos and Aquaria) and the world’s largest zoo and aquaria organisation, EAZA (European Association of Zoos and Aquaria). These memberships are very important for our breeding programs and for exchanging animals.

Company description: Archaeology Travel is an award wining travel website that aims to encourage and help everyone explore our world’s pasts in more sustainable and engaging ways. Name: Apple Museum
Company description: Our Museum Apple Museum offers tech history lessons through a timeline of valuable devices that changed the way people see a computing machine. In our Museum we present not only Apple Inc. but also Pixar Animation Studio and NeXT Company. An interactive tour guide is available in 8 languages helping you to follow the historic path of one of the most prestigious Computing Companies around the globe.  _______________________________________________________ Our Mission Apple Museum donates all profits to Charity. Name: Kunsthal Rotterdam

Company description: Rialto film theatre is a household name in Amsterdam with two distinct locations: Rialto De Pijp and Rialto VU. This is why the cinema screens many splendid European and American films as well as special gems from Latin America, Asia and Africa. Rialto spotlights non-Western cinema throughout the year, but especially in August during World Cinema Amsterdam. Another distinguishing feature of Rialto are its many specials. They have won prestigious national- and international awards (including an Oscar for Antonia, an Oscar nomination for Twin Sisters, an Emmy and three times the Prix Europa) and they scored national box office hits (Twin Sisters, Nynke, Oysters at Nam Kee's, Bride Flight). The company is dedicated to enhancing the enjoyment of cinema, offering a wide array of services that include online ticket sales, personalized content, and a loyalty program designed to reward frequent visitors. With a mission centered on customer satisfaction and data protection, The Space Cinema prioritizes the confidentiality of personal information in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Catering to a diverse audience, The Space Cinema serves families, film enthusiasts, and corporate clients seeking private screenings, creating a welcoming environment for all. The company partners with various film distributors and industry stakeholders to present a rich selection of films, ranging from blockbuster hits to independent productions, ensuring that there is something for everyone. Name: Stockholm Pride
Company description: Stockholm Pride is an annual LGBTQ Pride festival held in Stockholm, the capital of Sweden. Since the start in 1998, Stockholm Pride has grown dramatically. In 2013, some 55.000 to 60.000 participated and 600.000 followed the parade at the streets and the festival is now one of Sweden's largest public events. In 1998, 2008 and 2018 Stockholm Pride was also the host for Europride. Stockholm Pride is a non-profit organisation created and driven purely by volunteer work. We engage close to 600 volunteers during the festival. Half of the revenue needed for the festival is received through ticket sales, one quarter by exhibition and sales fees, and the last quarter through sponsorship and donations.  The celebrations normally starts with lectures and exhibitions all over the city on Monday. Pride House is the festival's cultural center. It is packed with seminars, debates, workshops, exhibitions, film, theater and other performances. On Wednesday it's the grand opening of Pride Park which is the festival arena visited by about 30.000 people during the week, where stalls, exhibitions, stages, restaurants, shops, and other attractions are built. Pride Park is open through Saturday and every night a wide variety of famous artists and shows appear on stage, showing their support for the LGBTQ Community. On Saturday, the main event called the Pride Parade is held. Many people have been out on the streets of Stockholm from early morning, anticipating one of Stockholms now largest public events, and enjoying the parade that ends in Pride Park for a huge Parade Celebration party. The festival is held in the end of July each year. For more information please visit our web page at www.stockholmpride.org.

Name: Zentropa
Company description: Zentropa was founded in 1992 by director Lars von Trier and producer Peter Aalbæk Jensen following their collaboration on Europa, which won three awards at the 1991 Cannes Film Festival. Within its short lifetime Zentropa has grown to become recognized as one of the most original and successful production companies in Europe winning the most prestigious awards on the international film scene.  Zentropa’s road to success was built on a progressive approach to film production that included room for artistic experimentation and financial risks. This culture has helped Zentropa build a unique brand and attract some of the finest talent of the Scandinavian film industries. An essential part of the rise to fame was the initial success and popularity of the works of Lars von Trier including the Cannes Film Festival Grand Prix-winning Breaking the Waves (1996) and the Palm D’or-winning Dancer in the Dark (2000). However, the Dogma 95-manifesto published by von Trier and three colleagues in 1995 arguably stands as the most iconic product of Zentropa’s innovative culture.  Over the years Zentropa has expanded the activities beyond the Danish borders with projects, collaborations on co-productions and the establishment of local production units in several European countries.  To date Zentropa has produced more than 200 films including a long list of genre-defining and award winning titles by renowned directors such as Lars von Trier, Susanne Bier, Thomas Vinterberg, Per Fly, Lone Scherfig, Nicolas Winding-Refn, Kristian Levring, Nikolaj Arcel, Mikkel Nørgaard, Annette K. Olesen, Christian E. Christiansen and many others. Company description: Sono passati più di 100 anni da quando Guido Reni ebbe per primo l’intraprendenza e la visione di evolvere il trasporto pubblico dal calesse ai mezzi a motore.  La storia della nostra famiglia e della nostra azienda attraversa tutto il ‘900 fino ad arrivare ai giorni nostri: Nel 1913 Guido Reni cercò di collegare l’Aspio con Camerano con una vettura a due cavalli: il calesse. Nel 1915 grazie alla comparsa della prima vettura a motore Guido Reni da il via a quel processo produttivo destinato ad evolvere il trasporto pubblico locale. L’autovettura acquistata viene impiegata in un sistema di messaggeria con il capoluogo, ma con l’inizio delle guerra viene requisita. Con la fine della prima guerra mondiale nel 1920 ritorna il sogno del trasporto motorizzato con l’acquisto di un Autobianchi C.B. a doppia ruota e a sette posti. Nel 1929 Reni costituisce una società per il trasporto di persone investendo per primo in un settore nuovo e tutto da esplorare. Nel 1953 i lussuosi e modernissimi autopullman sono presenti in tutte le contrade di Europa e grazie a Guido giungono sino al circolo polare Artico. L’organizzazione del trasporto di persone a grande raggio verrà apprezzata anche dal governo Inglese che darà la sua preferenza alla Reni per i viaggi dei suoi connazionali diretti in Italia per la visita ai cimiteri di guerra. Dopo più di 100 anni di storia oggi Reni è leader nel trasporto pubblico locale, internazionale, gran turismo e noleggio autobus da rimessa con conducente. L’esperienza acquisita sul campo è il nostro biglietto da visita e una garanzia per chi scegli di viaggiare con noi.

Company description: Constituída em finais de 1958, a CAEL tornou-se num dos primeiros players do mercado ao iniciar a atividade de aluguer de automóveis sem condutor no início de 1959, no seguimento da publicação do diploma que criou esta indústria.   Em Setembro de 1963, as duas famílias que ainda hoje são detentoras da CAEL adquiriram a totalidade do capital da empresa. Tendo como ponto de partida uma frota composta apenas por seis viaturas, a CAEL atingiu em poucos anos uma posição de destaque no setor, sobretudo na vertente do turismo.   Em 1975, a CAEL foi pioneira no aluguer de automóveis a empresas, tendo mantido uma frota de 500 viaturas em aluguer destinadas apenas a esta vertente e conquistando uma posição prestigiada graças à qualidade do serviço prestado e ao progressivo alargamento do leque de clientes. No final da década de 80, seguindo a tradição vanguardista que a caracteriza, a CAEL voltou a inovar com a criação de uma nova área de negócio, o aluguer de viaturas comerciais.   Dos anos 90 ao virar do milénio, a estratégia da CAEL passou pela entrada em novas sociedades. A par do sucesso da componente financeira, esta estratégia criou sinergias importantes, abrindo-se a novos horizontes e objetivos ambiciosos.   Presentemente, a CAEL dispõe de uma vasta frota direcionada para as mais diversas necessidades do mercado empresarial, assim como para o turismo mais exigente. Este posicionamento tem levado a necessários e avultados investimentos na aquisição e renovação constante da frota.   Atualmente, a gestão da CAEL integra três gerações das duas famílias que conduzem o seu destino há mais de meio século. Por essa razão, o know-how adquirido, a organização desenvolvida e o aperfeiçoamento de métodos, garantem um futuro próspero aos seus colaboradores, parceiros e, sobretudo, aos clientes, razão principal da existência da CAEL.

Company description: At its start in 1992, Hamilton Travel had organised about six tours and carried around 250 passengers abroad. Hamilton Travel, in essence, is an incoming and outgoing tour operator, organising its own tours, constantly in search of great deals with airlines, cruise liners, hotels, cars and coach companies.  We also cater for individual travellers who may opt to travel alone for leisure or business purposes, and are also equipped to help soon-to-be-wed couples organise their dream honeymoon. Flights, accommodation, car hire, trains, football and concert and theatre tickets may all be booked through Hamilton Travel. The company is one of the top three outgoing travel enterprises on the island. Since 1996, Hamilton Travel has been the exclusive Malta General Sales Agent for one of the world’s top cruise line companies – MSC Crociere.  Over 8,000 Maltese people travel on cruises out of Malta each year.  Our company also carries out shore excursions for the foreign passengers on board the MSC ships. We are one of the leading companies in MICE and are the local representatives for several European travel agents for group and individual travel, organising flights, hotel and private apartment accommodation, sightseeing tours, transfers and private chauffeur and self drive cars for people attending MICE conferences. We also provide a personal meet and greet service at the airport or/and sea port. Air Malta, our island’s national carrier, counts Hamilton Travel as its number one partner in the Maltese travel business, both in the incoming and outgoing sectors. We specialise in outgoing and incoming tours together with ensuring the requirements of individual travellers are met. We are proud to form part of the main tour and individual travel operators in Malta.

Name: Naviglio Viaggi Business Travel
Company description: How it started: In the summer of 1978, I applied to a job offer from Best Tours, a tour operator in Milan, for the position of promoter for the sale of their tour packages to agencies throughout Italy. This experience lasted about 4 years and allowed me to get an idea of how the tourist market was organized in Italy. So in 1982 I decided to open a travel agency on my own in Cernusco sul Naviglio. Those years were formidable for tourism, travel agents were the only way to book a flight, a train, or any other tourist service. Practically, the technology was still primitive: no computers or fax, only the telephone and in some agencies, like our, at most the teletype. Year after year we managed to build and consolidate a good reputation in our neighborhood, I remember the long queues of clients who formed in the agency in those years, mainly in Spring and before of  Holidays season,  We were important to customers but also to our suppliers, such as airlines or tour operators. Obviously, year after year with the advent of electronics, our work became increasingly less manual and more digital.  Up to these days, when I can even just with my smartphone in few minutes book and issue air tickets, or book a hotel or a car and then send everything by email to my client. It has been a fantastic experience to have gone through all these changes in more than 40 years of being a business travel agent. And it's not over yet!

Therefore, our team at Colibra is building a new type of product to increase the demand for air travel by providing peace of mind to air passengers and guaranteeing their rights. Product overview The 'Fly Now, Pay If Okay' product lets users book plane tickets through Colibra’s mobile app and wait until their flight arrives before having to pay. If the flight is cancelled within 7 days prior to the scheduled departure time or delayed by 3+ hours, passengers don’t have to pay for their tickets at all. In other words, the cost is entirely on us. By ensuring that passengers only pay for trips that aren’t disrupted, Colibra removes the worry of trying to claim refunds and compensations from airlines and saves its users time and hours of stress. How does it work 1. The passenger chooses a flight - it must depart and arrive within 30 days from booking date 2. Adds his/her personal data - Colibra doesn’t charge at the time of booking 3. Colibra charges the passenger upon arrival if everything goes smoothly and the service is delivered (ticket’s price is at no extra cost). In all other cases, the user travels for FREE.

Allt med information om tillgänglighet och vägbeskrivning dit. Barnens Karta ska vara den bästa tjänsten för ett samlat utbud av aktiviteter för barn och unga.  Barnens Karta vill motverka den trend med minskad rörelse och försämrad folkhälsa som sker. Att bidra till rörelse, aktiviteter och hälsa för barn och ungdomar är vårt primära mål. Integration kan underlättas och utanförskap kan förebyggas genom föreningsliv, aktiviteter, idrott, simkunnighet och kultur. Det vet vi. Däri ligger våra hjärtefrågor. Name: Krateo PlatformOps

Single-handedly monitoring and controlling resources: Krateo also acts as a centralized control plane, letting users monitor anything ranging from CI/CD pipelines to pod statuses and open tickets on your JIRA. Company description: Engage with consumers in real-time and based on their location through mobile wallets, such as Apple Wallet and Android Pay, and beacon technology. What is Passworks? These passes are dynamic, which means that can be updated constantly and in real-time so consumers can be always up-to-date. Also, these passes can be location-based actionable, through geo-reference (GPS) for outdoor locations or beacon technology, for indoor/in-store locations. This is a new concept called proximity marketing which allows brands to provide personalized in-store experiences for their consumers, based on their location, without the need to developing an App. The goal of using mobile as a marketing strategy is to link brick-and-mortar stores to digital content (or ecommerce) while creating stronger engagement and, ultimately, to drive store traffic.  Whether big, medium or small businesses, communication agencies or e-commerce, Passworks has a solution for you through our Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform or an Application Program Interface (API). How does it Work? Step 1) Choose the type of pass you want to create and design it with your brand look & feel; Step 2) Add content and associate locations to trigger lock-screen notifications to remind your consumers about the pass; Step 3) Distribute the passes and keep it an open and ongoing communication channel by updating the pass and sending relevant push notifications. Consumers download the pass and when are near the locations you previously defined, receive a notification with the pass, allowing it to see the pass on the lock screen and, well, might as well go into the store and use the pass before it expires! Want to know more? Contact us at hello@passworks.io!

Name: Gastronomia Cornelia Poletto
Company description: Benvenuti Liebe Gäste, liebe Freunde, ich begrüße Sie ganz herzlich auf meiner Webseite. Das CORNELIA POLETTO ist seit dem 1. Juni 2011 geöffnet und steht Ihnen von nun an auch online zur Verfügung. Seien Sie auch hier mein Gast und entdecken neben Bewährtem immer wieder Neues aus meinem kulinarischen Kosmos. Leben ist Veränderung. Mit meiner „Gastronomia“ habe ich mir einen lang gehegten Traum erfüllt: einen Feinkostladen mit angeschlossenem Restaurant. Familiär. Unkompliziert. Mit viel Kontakt zu den Gästen.  20 Jahre Sterneküche haben mich geprägt. Nach Schließung meines alten Restaurants, des POLETTO, verpflichte ich mich auch in Zukunft dem Kochen auf hohem Niveau mit erstklassigen Produkten. Mein Küchenteam aus Sternezeiten, meine „Sterntaler“, wie ich sie nenne, habe ich in mein neues Restaurant mitgenommen. Wir haben den Anspruch, den Besuch jeden Gastes zu einem ganz besonderen zu machen – ob er ein Menü genießt, das er sich aus der wechselnden Karte selbst zusammenstellen kann, einen Feierabendwein trinkt oder frische Zutaten für sein ganz privates Kocherlebnis einkauft. Fernab von Öffnungszeiten können Sie hier in den virtuellen Regalen meines Online-Shops stöbern.   Ihre Cornelia Poletto  301.338 qkm Italien passen tatsächlich auf 100 qm Eppendorf! Das CORNELIA POLETTO orientiert sich an der Idee der traditionellen, italienischen Gastronomia, einem Delikatessengeschäft mit der Möglichkeit zum Verweilen. Im Mittelpunkt steht die mediterrane italienische Küche – sowohl auf dem Herd als auch in den Regalen. Schmecken und schnuppern Sie sich durch unser Sortiment und die täglich wechselnde Karte. Die Speisen werden nach Cornelia Polettos persönlichem Küchen-Credo zubereitet: "Wirklich gutes Essen kann nur aus wirklich guten Produkten entstehen". Neben Klassikern werden Sie bei uns immer wieder Neues, Außergewöhnliches entdecken. Alles, was Sie sehen, können Sie auch mit nach Hause nehmen. Dazu gibt es Zubereitungstipps alla Poletto. Und falls Sie doch keine Lust haben, selber zu kochen, dann bleiben Sie einfach spontan da und lassen sich mit Pasta, Fisch oder dem besten halben Hühnchen der Stadt verwöhnen.  Cucina Cornelia Poletto Nur einen Messerwurf von meiner Eppendorfer Gastronomia entfernt finden Sie die „Cucina Cornelia Poletto“ – meine eigene Kochschule. Hier gebe ich regelmäßig Kochkurse zu den unterschiedlichsten kulinarischen Themengebieten. Sie haben keine Lust, selbst zu kochen? Kein Problem - beim „Chef’s Table“ bereiten mein Team und ich für Sie ein Vier-Gänge-Menü zu, während Sie den Abend in schöner Atmosphäre genießen. Natürlich dürfen Sie mir beim Kochen über die Schulter und in die Töpfe gucken. Dabei erkläre ich Ihnen gerne jeden Handgriff. Ich würde mich freuen, Sie bald in meiner Cucina begrüßen zu dürfen! Herzlichst, Ihre Cornelia Poletto

Name: Lolina VIntage Cafe
Company description: Lolina es un café vintage decorado con muebles y papeles pintados originales de los años 50, 60 y 70.  En el Lolina se puede desayunar, comer, merendar y cenar, además de tomar cóckteles y copas.  Los desayunos -desde 2,5 euros- son personalizados con una gran varidad de opciones a elegir, tanto dulces como saladas.  La carta del Lolina tiene diferentes tipos de ensaladas, delicionas exquisiteces francesas para picar, grandes tostas calientes y una selección de tartas caseras que te trasladarán a tu niñez.  Las tardes en el Lolina son ideales para disfrutar de uno de los 15 tipos de tés e infusiones directamente traídos del sur de la soleada California.  Entrada la noche, las chicas del Lolina preparan mojitos y caipirinhas siguiendo la receta original de La Floridita de la Habana. Pero si lo que se prefierer es algo más natural, también tenemos una amplia lista de zumos y batidos hechos con frutas exóticas. ¿QUÉ SON LOS 60 Y 70 SIN UN GUATEQUE? En honor a aquellos maravillosos años, la parte de abajo de el Lolina tiene un saloncito con sofás y butacas donde, además de pasar las tardes superagusto descansando y hablando, los jueves, viernes y sábados se organizan animados guateques.  La salita de guateque tiene una cabina donde vienen diferentes djs a pinchar música ye-ye mientras en una auténtica barra de finales de los 60 se sirven copichuelas .  Los espejos son la parte fundamental del salón. En ellos se reflejan todos los invitados al guateque para revivir la complicidad de aquellas miradas "inocentes" que nuestros padres se marcaban escuchando a Los Brincos.

Name: El Castañar De Aracena

Name: Hotel Reina Cristina - Granada
Company description: En palabras de Federico García Lorca, poeta universal, queremos que su estancia y experiencia sea la idónea para que sueñe y ensueñe Granada. En un enclave privilegiado, en pleno casco histórico de Granada, la zona cultural y comercial por excelencia, queremos ser partícipes directos de su experiencia contribuyendo a que sea inolvidable ofreciéndole no sólo la mejor estancia sino el trato más personalizado y familiar. Disfrute de su estancia y recréese con la historia alojada en nuestro Hotel que se remonta desde el S. XIX hasta la actualidad, pasando a la posteridad por ser la Residencia de la Familia Rosales, lugar en donde se refugió Federico García Lorca. Alojado desde el 9 de agosto de 1936, tras los violentos y sucesivos registros perpetrados en la Huerta de San Vicente en los días posteriores a la sublevación del 18 de Julio, el poeta pasó sus últimos días de felicidad junto a su íntimo amigo Luís Rosales hasta que desgraciadamente el 16 de agosto de 1936 fue detenido. Finalmente, el Poeta fue trasladado a la localidad de Víznar, donde dos días después, en la madrugada del 18 de agosto de 1936, silenciaron su voz, pero jamás su luz. Un acogedor hall de entrada da la bienvenida a sus clientes ofreciéndoles recepción 24 horas al día, sala de televisión, sala de conferencias con conexión a Internet, Garaje privado, Snack – Bar y un magnífico Restaurante a la carta donde el disfrute de sus guisos hará su estancia aún mas acogedora. Otras prestaciones adicionales son el servicio de habitaciones y de lavandería.

Company description: See-Villa is a beautiful romantic lake hotel like no other. It is a 129 year old historic summer resort hotel in Millstatt prominently located at the shores of lake Millstätter See featuring a private beach area, first-class restaurant, spa and recreational facilities, and 42 magnificent rooms with century-old aristocratic flair and modern luxury. Name: Les Clefs D'Or GERMANY
Company description: Welcome to “Die Goldenen Schlüssel” (The Golden Keys) – Germany’s only professional association of hotel concierges in the luxury hotel business. Numbering 180 active and 70 passive members, we live and work throughout the whole of Germany, pursuing our vocation: providing a cordial and, above all, very personal and competent service to national and international travellers. We see ourselves as hosts who are always in tune with the times. Whatever happens in our city – new bars and restaurants opening, the private grand opening of a store, the latest club events, exhibitions and concerts – we are always the first to hear about it. Meaning that we can provide exact information about the event and also get first choice when it comes to obtaining tickets. But that’s by far not everything we have to offer. It goes without saying that we can also charter a private aircraft in the space of a few hours, arrange for a luxury department store to open late in the evening, have letters delivered in person to the other end of the world or get hold of a really special handbag with that favourite label, despite actually no longer being available. Which almost sounds like a cross between James Bond and David Copperfield, don’t you think? No wonder we are constantly asked how we manage to do it – namely, make the impossible happen.  The answer is obvious: our network is our key to success. After all, “Die Goldenen Schlüssel” concierges are engaged in continuous exchange, providing advice and support to one another. Thanks to state-of-the-art communications, this can be done quickly and effectively. At the same time, we are committed to maintaining traditional virtues, always serving our guests and partners with sincerity, respect and honesty, which we consider the only way to establish long-term relations. In addition, we leverage the knowledge of each individual member, enabling us to improve our skills as a group and to identify new talents in our industry.   In a nutshell: “Die Goldenen Schlüssel” is a professional association of people who pursue the same aim, working hand in hand together. Namely, “In Service through Friendship”.

CUBE is not just a hotel, but a large living room in the mountains - life takes place outside the room. Generous public areas at all levels of the CUBE enhance communication. CUBE - IT’S YOUR HOMEBASE.

La Trattoria tiene tres plantas e incorpora elementos de corte tradicional como la elaboración diaria de pasta fresca  a la vista de los comensales con otros más modernos como la presencia de una cabina de dj en medio del local o pantallas audiovisuales distribuidas por el restaurante.  En la cocina destacan, con una esmerada presentación, platos como el risotto al funghi porcini o la ciottola di foie, la zuppe di minestrone y por supuesto, el postre italiano por excelencia, el tiramisú. El local cuenta con una decoración muy atractiva y un ambiente extremadamente agradable durante toda la semana. La entrada se encuentra en planta calle con el comedor principal con vistas al exterior y perfectamente diseñado para que los comensales cuenten con cierta privacidad, gracias a su amplio salón dividido en reservados y salas de distintas capacidades con alguna con vistas a la bodega de la Trattoria San Paolo. Las escaleras conducen a otros comedores en la planta inferior y a la zona de copas que cuenta con una decoración impactante, efectos visuales y un explosivo cóctel musical con set de dj incluido donde poder tomar la primera copa o seguir disfrutando de la noche o tomarse la primera copa escuchando buena música internacional. Tenemos amplia experiencia colaborando en la organización de eventos privados y corporativos. En función del encuentro disponemos de menús para grupos y cócteles a partir de 10 comensales con presupuestos muy variados. El local es perfecto para organizar almuerzos de trabajo o celebrar un cumpleaños o fiesta sorpresa ya que es todo un descubrimiento en medio de Madrid… Puede pedir presupuesto sin ningún compromiso a nuestro departamento de Reservas.

Name: Travel Builders
Company description: Wat? Travel Builders is een mobiele app voor reizigers waar alle informatie over hun reis in staat. Centraal staat een tijdslijn met alle reisonderdelen als vluchten, transfers, accommodaties en activiteiten. Vanaf de tijdslijn kan de reiziger doorklikken naar detailinformatie over het reisonderdeel met tekst, foto’s en bijlagen zoals e-tickets en vouchers. De reiziger kan zelf per dag notities toevoegen en via de app communiceren met de reisorganisatie. Al deze info is offline beschikbaar, zonder dure internetverbinding in het buitenland. Naast deze grote lijnen zijn er nog veel meer handige functies en mogelijkheden. Hoe? Travel Builders heeft een online platform ontwikkeld voor reisorganisaties. De reisorganisaties kunnen in dit platform een database met reisonderdelen opbouwen en vanuit deze database reizen samenstellen voor een klant. Deze reis kunnen ze als interactieve reisgids plaatsen in een mobiele app voor de klant. Eigen app voor reisorganisaties Deelnemende reisorganisaties krijgen een app onder hun eigen naam in de appstores van Google en Apple. De app waar de klanten straks mee op reis gaan is de app van de reisorganisatie. Een eigen app geeft een professionele uitstraling en geeft toegang tot tal van marketing en upsell mogelijkheden. Denk alleen al aan het gemak waarmee klanten de reis -en daarmee de app en uitstraling van de reisorganisatie- aan vrienden gaan laten zien. Natuurlijk hebben we ook gedacht aan ratings en klanttevredenheid. Travel Builders heeft goed nagedacht over de behoefte van de reiziger in combinatie met functionele- en marketing uitdagingen van reisorganisaties. Gesprekken met reisorganisaties, marketeers en een marktonderzoek staan aan de basis van het Travel Builders concept.
